A power moonroof lets in natural light, and front fog lights enhance visibility in challenging weather. An exterior rear parking camera aids reversing confidence, and adaptive cruise control handles highway speed management with ease. Forward collision warning with autonomous emergency braking and lane departure warning round out a serious suite of active safety technology. A power liftgate adds everyday convenience, and the 2.0L TSI DOHC engine paired with the 8-speed automatic with Tiptronic delivers energetic, confident performance in all conditions with the security of 4Motion AWD.

This 2023 Hyundai Tucson SEL in White offers a practical and reliable option for drivers seeking a versatile midsize SUV with modern conveniences and dependable performance. With 44,699 miles on the odometer, this vehicle represents an excellent value for those looking to maximize their investment in quality transportation.

This Tucson SEL is equipped with features that enhance both comfort and convenience:

- All-wheel drive for confident handling in various weather conditions
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone integration
- Bluetooth connectivity for hands-free calling and audio streaming
- Heated front seats for added comfort during colder months
- Rear backup camera for enhanced visibility when reversing

- Tow hitch for light hauling capabilities

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine with direct injection delivers 187 horsepower and achieves an estimated 23 mpg city and 28 mpg highway, paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC for responsive driving dynamics. The interior features power windows, power door mirrors with heating capability, and a tilt and telescoping steering wheel for optimal positioning. Climate control is managed through automatic temperature regulation, and the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in winter conditions.

Safety features include four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, dual front impact airbags, front and rear side-impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system. The vehicle also features a security system with panic alarm and automatic headlights that transition from parking lights to full beam as needed. The 17-inch alloy wheels are mounted on a four-wheel independent suspension system that balances comfort with responsive handling.

This Tucson SEL stands ready to deliver dependable service with the features and capability you need for daily driving and weekend adventures. The combination of practical design, modern technology, and proven Hyundai reliability makes this an attractive option for discerning buyers.

Integrated voice command with Bluetooth keeps you connected safely while the steering wheel controls and hands-free capability maintain focus on the road.

The Uconnect 4C navigation system with its 8.4" touchscreen serves as the command center for your driving experience. The system includes SiriusXM satellite radio access, HD Radio capabilities, GPS navigation, and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot to keep passengers entertained and informed. The 9 amplified speakers with subwoofer deliver quality audio throughout the cabin.

Safety features work quietly in the background to provide peace of mind. Anti-lock brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to maintain vehicle stability. Multiple airbags protect occupants, while the ParkView rear backup camera assists during parking maneuvers. Low tire pressure warning alerts you to maintenance needs before they become problems.

This Cherokee Limited represents a practical choice for those seeking dependable 4WD capability combined with daily-use comfort features. The clean vehicle history with no accidents speaks to the vehicle's condition, and the included warranty provides additional assurance. The SH-AWD system delivers confident handling in all weather conditions, while the 3.7L V6 SOHC VTEC engine provides dependable performance. The power driver and passenger seats offer individual adjustability, and heated front sport seats add warmth during cold months.

Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to support confident braking and handling. The occupant sensing airbag system provides appropriate protection for all passengers.

The three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to seven passengers, with split-folding rear seats that expand cargo capacity when needed. Power windows, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, and auto-dimming rear-view mirror add layers of convenience to daily operation. Xenon headlights and front fog lights enhance visibility, while speed-sensitive wipers adjust automatically to changing weather conditions.

This MDX Technology model combines capability with comfort features that make longer trips more enjoyable and daily commutes more convenient. The Sport Handling All-Wheel Drive system and proven V6 engine deliver a balance of performance and reliability. With thoughtful design and comprehensive equipment, this vehicle is ready to serve your transportation needs.

The 2026 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali Crew Cab is finished in Onyx Black Paint and fitted with a 4.5 MCGAUGHY'S lift with stainless inserts and a four-wheel alignment, giving the truck a more substantial stance without changing the fact that it is still a heavy-duty Denali built around capability. It rides on 20 FUEL ARC D796 black wheels wrapped in 37X12.50R20 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, and the suspension and wheel package are paired with professionally installed window tint that carries a lifetime warranty. Those additions are matched to the truck's formal Denali trim, which brings the kind of equipment expected in a well-specified HD pickup while keeping the presentation clean and controlled.

Inside, the cabin uses Leather Seats and a Power Sunroof to create a more refined environment than a basic work truck, while the Denali Reserve Package adds another layer of equipment to the interior and trim. The Technology Package brings together the electronic features that support daily driving, including Head Up Display, Rear Camera Mirror, Collision Warning, and Adaptive Cruise Control. A Premium Audio system and Wi-Fi Hotspot are included as well, so the truck is set up for long highway miles and connected use without requiring aftermarket additions. The Crew Cab format provides the rear-seat room associated with this body style, and the interior presentation remains consistent with the Denali nameplate's more polished finish.

Mechanically, the Sierra 2500HD is equipped with the diesel-focused hardware and towing-related items expected on a heavy-duty GMC. The 220 Amp Alternator, Exhaust Brake, High Idle Switch, Engine Block Heater, and Winter Grille Cover are all part of the equipment list, along with Federal Emissions Requirements. The 3.42 Rear Axle Ratio is paired with the Gooseneck / 5th Wheel Prep Package, and the truck also includes Roof Marker Lamps and a GVWR of 11350 lbs. Power Retractable Assist Steps make entry and exit more convenient, and the truck is fitted with a Power Sunroof rather than the standard closed roof panel. The presence of these items gives the truck a clear emphasis on utility without relying on unnecessary embellishment.

The exterior and chassis details continue that same straightforward approach. The body color, black wheel finish, and lifted suspension are complemented by the larger tire size and the stainless trim elements in the lift kit, while the window tint adds a finished look to the glass without altering the truck's factory character. The Denali-specific trim and options package content keep the cab and body aligned with GMC's higher-spec treatment, and the heavy-duty underpinnings remain central to the vehicle's identity. Introducing the 2026 GMC Canyon Denali a premium mid-size truck built to deliver capability and refinement for drivers who expect both performance and comfort.

- Premium 7-Speaker Bose Sound System
- Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control Air Conditioning
- 8-Way Power Driver Seat Adjuster with Driver Memory
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Canyon Safety Plus Package
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- Front LED Fog Lamps with IntelliBeam Automatic High Beam
- Spray-on Bedliner with GMC Logo
- Wireless Phone Charging
- Navigation System with 11.3 Diagonal Premium GMC Infotainment System
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Automatic Emergency Braking with Front Pedestrian Detection
- Multicolor 6.3 Head-Up Display
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with Heated Steering Wheel
- 20 x 9 Diamond Cut Dark Gray Aluminum Wheels

The Canyon Denali combines a 2.7L turbocharged four-cylinder engine producing 310 horsepower with an eight-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive, delivering 17 city and 22 highway mpg. This powertrain provides the responsiveness you need whether navigating city streets or tackling demanding terrain, while the four-wheel drive system ensures confident handling in varied conditions.

Inside, the Denali trim elevates the truck experience with perforated leather-appointed seat trim and an array of comfort features designed for long drives. Heated and ventilated front seats adapt to seasonal temperatures, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control keep you comfortable year-round. The eight-way power driver seat with memory function learns your preferred position and recalls it automatically each time you enter the truck.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine. The premium infotainment system features wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, allowing you to access your phone's apps and navigation without physical cables. The multicolor head-up display projects critical driving information directly into your line of sight, keeping your attention on the road ahead. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio brings satellite, online, and mobile streaming entertainment wherever you travel.

Safety technology works behind the scenes to help protect you and your passengers. Adaptive cruise control maintains your set speed and distance from vehicles ahead, while lane keep assist and lane departure warning help you stay centered in your lane. Automatic emergency braking with front pedestrian detection provides an additional safety layer, and the Canyon Safety Plus Package adds features specifically engineered to help prevent accidents.

The bed is equipped with a spray-on bedliner featuring the GMC logo for durability and style, while the EZ-Lift and lower tailgate makes loading easier. Chrome assist steps provide convenient entry, and the MultiStow tailgate storage compartment organizes your gear. With 120-volt power outlets in the bed and cabin, plus wireless charging capability, you can keep devices powered throughout the day.

This 2026 GMC Canyon Denali represents thoughtful truck design combining turbocharged efficiency with genuine capability, premium comfort with practical technology, and refined styling with dependable four-wheel drive performance. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it fits your needs.
